name: @alevr/env-server
description: Alevr Code local environment server: runs the user's own agent runtimes (Claude Agent SDK, codex app-server, ACP agents) and Alevr's engine behind one WebSocket protocol (alevr-code-v2).

scripts.bundle:mac: npm run build && esbuild src/bin.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --external:node-pty --banner:js='import { createRequire } from "node:module"; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);' --outfile=dist/alevr-env.mjs
